response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured engineer with genuine high-throughput experience (Sociomantic/dunnhumby micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests per second in D) and current, relevant exposure to agentic development via MCP code generators and AI-agent tooling at re:cinq. TypeScript is clearly a strength, and the founder/open-source track record shows ownership and systems breadth. However, the resume shows no Python — a must-have for this role — and limited evidence of the staff-level expectations around technical strategy at scale, cross-functional stakeholder management, and formal on-call/incident ownership. The profile reads more as a polyglot senior craftsman than a domain-directing staff IC, so a screening call is warranted to probe Python depth and strategy scope.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed micro-services experience
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work
Strong TypeScript/Node plus deep craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, own test frameworks)
concerns: No Python evidence anywhere in skills or roles
Thin proof of staff-level technical strategy and stakeholder management
No stated on-call, incident-response, or agile ceremony ownership
